Claim 21 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: force sensing material having a conductance that is configured to vary based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell; and force sensing circuitry coupled to the force sensing material, wherein the force sensing circuitry is configured to produce a force output signal based on the conductance of the force sensing material, __wherein the force sensing material is a quantum tunneling composite or a contact sensor.__

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 21, wherein the force sensing material comprises at least one variable electrical conductor.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 22, wherein the at least one variable electrical conductor has a first level of electrical conductance when the at least one variable electrical conductor is quiescent, and wherein the at least one variable electrical conductor has a second level of conductance when a mechanical stress is applied to the at least one variable electrical conductor.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 22, wherein the at least one variable electrical conductor __is a quantum tunneling composite or a pressure sensitive ink.__

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises __a contact sensor or at least one of a polymer membrane binary switch and a discrete dome switch.__
